input-field.name: apiUrl
input-field.label: TackQuote API base URL
TackQuote API-Basis-URL
input-field.helpText: Base URL of the TackQuote API, including /v1 and no trailing slash. Use http://localhost:3001/v1 for local development.
Basis-URL der TackQuote-API inkl. /v1, ohne abschließenden Schrägstrich.

input-field.name: tenantSlug
input-field.label: TackQuote tenant slug
TackQuote Mandanten-Slug
input-field.helpText: Your TackQuote workspace slug (e.g. "demo"). Required for the storefront "Request a Quote" button — it is submitted with every quote request so TackQuote routes it to the right account.
Der Slug deines TackQuote-Workspace. Wird für den Angebots-Button im Storefront benötigt.

input-field.name: apiKey
input-field.label: TackQuote API key
TackQuote API-Schlüssel
input-field.helpText: Create under TackQuote → Settings → Developer → API Keys. Not required for the storefront quote button today (that endpoint is tenant-slug scoped, not API-key authenticated) — reserved for a future dedicated Shopware plugin endpoint (order sync / catalog push). See this plugin's README for details.
Aktuell nicht für den Angebots-Button erforderlich. Reserviert für zukünftige Auftragssynchronisierung.

input-field.name: enableButton
input-field.label: Show "Request a Quote" button on product pages
"Angebot anfordern"-Button auf Produktseiten anzeigen

input-field.name: quoteOnlyMode
input-field.label: Run this storefront as a quote-only B2B catalog
Diesen Verkaufskanal als reinen B2B-Angebotskatalog betreiben
input-field.helpText: Disables adding products to the cart and blocks checkout for the audience selected below. Customers browse the catalog and use "Request a Quote" instead. Enforced on the server, not just hidden in the theme: a crafted request to /store-api/checkout/cart/line-item is refused with 403, and a cart filled before this switch was turned on can no longer be ordered. Administrators are always exempt, including "log in as customer" from the Administration, so you can still test the store.

Deaktiviert das Hinzufügen zum Warenkorb und blockiert den Checkout für die unten gewählte Zielgruppe. Kunden nutzen stattdessen "Angebot anfordern". Die Sperre wird serverseitig durchgesetzt, nicht nur im Theme ausgeblendet. Administratoren sind immer ausgenommen.

input-field.name: quoteOnlyScope
input-field.label: Applies to
Gilt für

option.name: Guests only (registered customers keep the cart)
Nur Gäste (registrierte Kunden behalten den Warenkorb)

input-field.helpText: "Guests only" is the usual B2B setup: anonymous visitors and guest checkouts must request a quote, while an approved, logged-in B2B customer can still order directly. An unrecognised value falls back to "Everyone" — the safe direction, since the master switch above is on.
"Nur Gäste" ist die übliche B2B-Einrichtung: Anonyme Besucher fordern ein Angebot an, freigeschaltete angemeldete B2B-Kunden können weiterhin direkt bestellen.

component.name: sw-entity-multi-id-select
quoteOnlyCustomerGroupIds
component.label: Customer groups
Kundengruppen
component.helpText: Only used when "Applies to" is set to "Specific customer groups". Leaving this empty with that scope selected means quote-only mode matches nobody and the store behaves normally.
Nur relevant, wenn oben "Bestimmte Kundengruppen" gewählt ist.
